rules.statement: In Markdown documentation such as decision records, write every issue or pull request reference as a full Markdown link to its GitHub URL (for example `[#56](https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/issues/56)`), never as a bare `#56`, and do this at every place in the document that mentions it.
rules.why: A bare `#56` only resolves in GitHub's own rendering. It stays plain text in other Markdown viewers, such as one used on a local clone.
rules.check: Search changed Markdown files for `#<number>` that isn't inside a Markdown link, including in Amends lines, option lists and Consequences bullets, especially when the same document links that number elsewhere.
